design_loads.note: These are conservative engineering verification envelopes, not predictions of final finished weight. Physical proof testing remains required before release.

brazil_material_policy.primary_structural_sheet: 18 mm naval/marine-grade plywood (compensado naval), preferably virola of good lamination quality; pinus naval acceptable if sheet quality passes inspection
sheet_acceptance_checks: measure actual thickness at multiple points
reject severe internal voids visible at edges or test coupon
verify CNC pocket/joint fit with physical tolerance coupon
brazil_material_policy.solid_wood_policy: No solid timber is required for primary strength. If a local builder prefers hardwood/pinus cleats they may be an approved alternative only where the drawings preserve the same load path and fastener bearing area. CNC-cut laminated plywood doublers are the baseline because they are repeatable and flat-pack friendly.

purpose: limit cabinet racking and bottom-panel span
avoid relying on the bottom skin alone for heavy components
lower_structural_crossmembers.ssf_rule: keep crossmembers low and outside primary SSF exciter wall zones; do not unnecessarily bridge/stiffen the side walls at exciter locations

main_cabinet_structure.heavy_components_rule: PC drawer, batteries/power supplies, large amplifiers and mechanical toys must mount to dedicated trays/crossmembers/rails; do not hang concentrated mass from the bottom panel skin alone.

leg_corners.baseline: two-layer 18 mm plywood CNC doubler/corner block plus steel leg bracket/backing hardware

rear_backbox_shelf.baseline: 18 mm shelf plus 18 mm underside doubler/crossmember at hinge/lock/passport zone

playfield_hinge_and_gas_strut_anchors.baseline: 18+18 mm plywood doubler or equivalent steel bracket tied into full-thickness structure

pc_drawer_slide_mounts.baseline: dedicated plywood subrails/doublers tied to crossmembers

lockdown_bar_receiver.baseline: metal receiver tied into reinforced front structure; custom-width metalwork acceptable

joinery_and_fasteners.critical_load_fasteners: through-bolts, machine screws into metal-backed captive nuts/inserts, or documented equivalent
joinery_and_fasteners.adhesive: PVA/D3 or documented equivalent for permanent wood joints where assembly plan calls for glue; final adhesive spec to use products readily available in Brazil

electrical_safety_policy.rule: The cabinet is a toy/appliance, not a trap. Any reachable hazardous voltage is a blocking design defect until corrected.
